description: Rank by length among graded loci (grades A-D); empty for excluded rows (grade X).
Representative record: the longest live model of the locus (NCBI Protein, UniProtKB or UniParc UPI accession).
Organism as given by the record.
Length of the representative sequence in amino acids.

Final grade after all stages: A supported full-length model; B supported in parts; C no contradiction and no support line; D contradicted by at least one check; X excluded (synthetic or patent, partial, or no live record).
Grade after the sequence and locus checks only (Stage 1), before RNA-seq and source-read evidence.
Best grade among all models merged into this row (isoforms, copies, duplicate records).
Near-identical copies of the gene in other assemblies (support line S2), merged into this row.
Other records of the same gene in the same organism (haplotypes, GenBank and RefSeq versions, isoforms; >= 90 % shared 10-mers), merged into this row and not counted as independent support.
One-line summary of the checks that decided the grade: contradiction rule (D1-D5), support lines (S1-S4, S6 peptides), RNA-seq intron support, source-read verdicts per assembly, peptide evidence.
Evidence that would be needed to raise or confirm the grade, including whether PRIDE lists projects for the species (keyword match only; PXD025008 and PXD060105 were reanalysed).
Locus identifier: NCBI GeneID, contig region, MD5 of a sequence without locus, or 'copies:' for merged copy sets.
